scoring.scale: 1-10, higher is better; null means unmeasured.
scoring.cost: Artificial Analysis cost per Intelligence Index task at the routed effort. Log bands: floor(10 - 9 * ln(cost / 0.03) / ln(3.91 / 0.03)), clamped to 1-10; Luna high ($0.03/task) is 10, Fable 5.1 high ($3.91/task) is 1. Current scores match starting effort; historical measurements at other efforts stay in score_evidence.
scoring.intelligence: Peak Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index: round(1 + 9 * (index - 30) / (58 - 30)), clamped to 1-10; 58 is 10 and 30 is 1. Benchmark effort is not routing authorization.
scoring.speed: Median output tokens per second relative to the fastest model.
scoring.taste: Owner judgment for UI/UX, code quality, API design, and copy.
scoring.order: Shipped work weighs intelligence, then taste, then cost; cost only breaks ties.
scoring.review: Historical Orchestrator V2 audit panel (T3 Code PR #2829, 2026-09-24) weighted mean relative to Astra 8.22 = 10. This panel did not measure GPT-6.1 Sol; current review routing follows the explicit owner preference, not this historical ranking.
scoring.allowance: How long the $200 plan lasts before a limit hits (Claude Max 20x, ChatGPT Pro 20x). Codex: published per-5-hour Pro 20x ranges (Astra 100-900, Luna 7,000-56,000), log scale. GPT-6.1 Sol allowance is unmeasured. Claude publishes no counts: Opus 5.5 is the owner's observed most generous; Fable 5.1 draws limits faster (list price 2.5x Opus 5.5) and is capped at 50% of the weekly limit.
